```{python}
#| label: ErrorsSVK
#| fig-cap: "Relative error with regards to FEniCS (SVK)"

import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd

# Relative nodal L2 errors against FEniCS SVK at 8 parameter sets outside the training grid
# NN-PGD: 12 greedy linear modes, then greedy SVK enrichment up to 20 modes (lowest error)
try:
    data = pd.read_csv("SVK_lung_6D_errors.csv")
except:
    data = pd.read_csv("Figures/SVK_lung_6D_errors.csv")

hover = ('E = %{customdata[0]:.2f} kPa<br>θ = %{customdata[1]:.2f}, φ = %{customdata[2]:.2f}<br>'
         'p₀ = %{customdata[3]:.2f} kPa<br>H = %{customdata[4]:.2f}, K = %{customdata[5]:.2f} Pa/mm<br>'
         'error = %{y:.1f} %<extra></extra>')
cd = data[['E_kPa', 'theta', 'phi', 'p0_kPa', 'H_Pa_mm', 'K_Pa_mm']].values

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=data['Point'], y=100 * data['NNPGD_error'],
    name='NN-PGD (SVK)',
    marker=dict(color='#3a46f5'),
    customdata=cd, hovertemplate=hover
))
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=data['Point'], y=100 * data['Linear_FEM_error'],
    name='Linear FEM',
    marker=dict(color='rgba(23, 15, 56, 0.35)'),
    customdata=cd, hovertemplate=hover
))

fig.update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',  # Remove background color
    width=450, 
    height=400,  
    barmode='group',
    xaxis=dict(title='Test parameter set',
               tickvals=list(range(1, 9)),
               showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(
        title=dict(
            text='Relative L² error (%)', 
            font=dict(color='#170f38')),
        tickfont=dict(color='#170f38'),
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray'
    ),
    legend=dict(x=0.02, y=1.0)
)

# Show the figure
fig.show()

```
